instructions.name: close_and_undelegate
docs: Final ER step: commit the shared result and winning escrow together.
Losing bid escrows return independently when their owners claim refunds.

instructions.name: finalize_auction
docs: Runs on Solana after the ER result is committed. Locks the winner and
returns only their unused maximum budget. The winning amount remains in
the vault until approved artwork and accepted fulfillment proof exist.

instructions.name: open_bid_escrow
docs: Locks a bidder's maximum spend on Solana before any ER bid is accepted.

instructions.name: place_bid
docs: Runs on the hosted ER; the locked token balance remains on Solana.

accounts.name: bidder
docs: public bidder identity. The actual signer may be this wallet or its

instructions.name: release_payment
docs: Releases the winning amount only after the winner's artwork has been
approved and the winner has accepted the creator's fulfillment proof.
